name: Midtown Manhattan
desc: The city's busiest core around Times Square, Fifth Ave and Rockefeller Center. Endless subway lines and short commutes, but mostly high-rise rentals with premium prices.
desc_zh: 围绕时代广场、第五大道和洛克菲勒中心的城市核心区，地铁线路极多、通勤最短；以高层出租公寓为主，租金高、比较喧闹。

name: Midtown East
desc: Around Grand Central and Turtle Bay: doorman high-rises, a calmer after-work feel and fast subway/Metro-North access. Popular with finance and consulting staff; rents are high.
desc_zh: 中央车站与龟湾一带，多为门卫高层公寓，下班后相对安静，地铁和Metro-North通勤便利；金融、咨询从业者多，租金偏高。

name: Midtown West
desc: Hell's Kitchen and the Theater District: lively restaurant rows, new towers near the Hudson and quick trains from Times Square and Port Authority. Busy, young and pricey.
desc_zh: 地狱厨房和剧院区，餐厅林立、夜生活丰富，哈德逊河边新楼多，时代广场和巴士总站交通方便；氛围年轻热闹，租金不低。

name: Financial District (FiDi)
desc: Wall Street's canyons turned residential: converted towers with gyms and doormen, nearly every subway line plus PATH and ferries. Quiet on weekends, better value than Midtown.
desc_zh: 华尔街一带，许多写字楼改建为带健身房和门卫的公寓，几乎所有地铁线加PATH和轮渡汇集；周末偏安静，性价比好于中城。

name: Hudson Yards
desc: Manhattan's newest district: glassy luxury towers, the Vessel, the High Line and a big mall, served by the 7 train. Polished and convenient, with some of the city's highest rents.
desc_zh: 曼哈顿最新开发区，玻璃幕墙豪华高楼、Vessel、高线公园和大型商场，乘7号线可达；环境精致便利，租金属全市最高之列。

credits.author: Ajay Suresh from New York, NY, USA

name: Flatiron / NoMad
desc: Around the Flatiron Building and Madison Square Park: prewar lofts, great restaurants and many subway lines. Central and stylish, loved by tech and creative workers; rents are high.
desc_zh: 熨斗大厦与麦迪逊广场公园周边，战前loft建筑漂亮、餐厅出色、地铁线多；位置居中、很有格调，深受科技和创意从业者喜爱，租金较高。

credits.author: Eden, Janine and Jim from New York City

name: Chelsea
desc: Brownstones, art galleries, the High Line and Chelsea Market on Manhattan's west side. Walkable and social, with A/C/E and 1 trains; rents run high.
desc_zh: 曼哈顿西侧，褐石排屋、画廊、高线公园和切尔西市场汇聚，步行友好、社交氛围浓，A/C/E和1号线通达；租金偏高。

name: Union Square
desc: A lively hub around the park and Greenmarket, steps from NYU and The New School. Many subway lines meet here, making it a top student pick; expect small, pricey units.
desc_zh: 以联合广场公园和农夫市集为中心，紧邻NYU和新学院；多条地铁线交汇，是学生热门选择，但房型偏小、租金较贵。

name: SoHo
desc: Cobblestone streets, cast-iron lofts and flagship stores. Stylish and central, but apartments are scarce, often walk-ups, and among Manhattan's most expensive.
desc_zh: 鹅卵石街道、铸铁loft建筑和品牌旗舰店聚集，时尚且位置居中；但房源稀少、多为无电梯楼，租金在曼哈顿属顶级。

name: Downtown Brooklyn
desc: A fast-growing cluster of new high-rises near MetroTech, NYU Tandon and Barclays Center. A dozen subway lines reach Manhattan in minutes, with more space for the money.
desc_zh: MetroTech、NYU Tandon和巴克莱中心附近新建高楼密集，十余条地铁线几分钟到曼哈顿；同样预算比曼哈顿空间更大。

name: Long Island City (LIC)
desc: Queens waterfront towers facing the Midtown skyline, one stop from Manhattan on the 7, E/M and N/W. Newer amenity buildings at slightly lower rents than Manhattan.
desc_zh: 皇后区滨水高楼，正对中城天际线，乘7、E/M、N/W一站到曼哈顿；楼新、设施全，租金略低于曼哈顿。

name: Hoboken, NJ
desc: A compact, walkable mile-square city of brownstones and bars on the Hudson. A young-professional favorite; PATH and ferries reach Manhattan in 10–15 min, rents a bit lower.
desc_zh: 哈德逊河畔一平方英里的小城，褐石建筑和酒吧林立，年轻上班族最爱；PATH和轮渡10–15分钟到曼哈顿，租金略低。

name: Newport, NJ
desc: A planned waterfront community of high-rise rentals with a mall, riverside walkway and its own PATH stop. Quiet and safe-feeling, with easy commutes to Midtown or Downtown.
desc_zh: 规划型滨水社区，以高层出租公寓为主，配有商场和河滨步道，自带PATH站；安静、安全感强，通勤中城或下城都方便。

name: Exchange Place, NJ
desc: Jersey City's financial waterfront of glass towers with Lower Manhattan views. One PATH stop to WTC; new luxury rentals, quiet after office hours.
desc_zh: 泽西市的金融滨水区，玻璃高楼林立，正对下曼哈顿景观；PATH一站到世贸中心，新建豪华公寓多，下班后较安静。

name: Grove St, NJ
desc: Downtown Jersey City's social heart: brownstones, a pedestrian plaza, bars and restaurants. PATH to WTC or 33rd St; popular with young renters and good value vs. Manhattan.
desc_zh: 泽西市下城的社交中心，褐石排屋、步行广场、酒吧餐厅聚集；PATH可到世贸或33街，年轻租客多，比曼哈顿划算。

name: Journal Square (JSQ), NJ
desc: Jersey City's transit hub, booming with new high-rise rentals around the PATH station. More affordable than the waterfront, about 20 min to Manhattan, with diverse food.
desc_zh: 泽西市交通枢纽，PATH站周边新建高层公寓不断；租金比滨水区更亲民，约20分钟到曼哈顿，各国美食丰富。

name: Midtown Manhattan
desc: 34th–59th St: one of NYC's largest core business districts, home to finance, media, consulting, tech and corporate HQs.
desc_zh: 34至59街一带，纽约最大的核心商务区之一，汇聚金融、传媒、咨询、科技和企业总部。

name: Midtown East
desc: Grand Central, Park Ave and Lexington Ave: the traditional corporate core of banks, law firms, consulting and finance.
desc_zh: 中央车站、公园大道和列克星敦大道一带，传统企业办公核心，银行、律所、咨询和金融机构集中。

name: Midtown West
desc: Times Square, Hudson Yards and Hell's Kitchen: media, entertainment, tech and new-generation office towers and HQs.
desc_zh: 时代广场、哈德逊园区和地狱厨房一带，传媒、娱乐、科技公司与新一代写字楼和总部集中。

name: Financial District (FiDi)
desc: Wall Street and the World Trade Center: the traditional financial center for banks, insurance, financial services and government.
desc_zh: 华尔街与世贸中心一带，传统金融中心，银行、保险、金融服务和政府机构集中。

name: Hudson Yards
desc: West 30s: an emerging high-end district of major corporate HQs, finance, tech and luxury retail.
desc_zh: 西30街一带的新兴高端商务区，大型企业总部、金融、科技和高端零售集中。

credits.author: Ajay Suresh from New York, NY, USA

name: Flatiron / NoMad
desc: Broadway and Fifth Ave in the 20s–30s: a hub for tech, creative, design, advertising and startups.
desc_zh: 百老汇与第五大道20至30街段，科技、创意、设计、广告和初创公司聚集地。

credits.author: Eden, Janine and Jim from New York City

name: Chelsea
desc: West 14th–30th St: strong in tech, media, advertising and art, anchored partly by Google's large presence.
desc_zh: 西14至30街，科技、传媒、广告和艺术产业发达，谷歌大型办公室是重要支柱。

name: Union Square
desc: Around 14th St: tech, startups, retail and creative firms, with many young companies.
desc_zh: 14街一带，科技、初创、零售和创意公司集中，年轻企业众多。

name: SoHo
desc: Houston to Canal St: fashion, luxury retail, creative agencies and brand headquarters.
desc_zh: Houston街至Canal街之间，时尚、奢侈品零售、创意机构和品牌总部集中。

name: Downtown Brooklyn
desc: Civic Center and MetroTech: Brooklyn's largest business center for finance, tech, government and education.
desc_zh: 布鲁克林市政中心和MetroTech一带，布鲁克林最大的商务中心，涵盖金融、科技、政府和教育。

name: Long Island City (LIC)
desc: Queens Plaza and Court Square: a main Queens office hub for tech, media, converted industrial space and corporate offices.
desc_zh: 皇后广场和Court Square一带，皇后区主要办公枢纽，科技、传媒、工业改造空间和企业办公集中。

name: Santa Monica
desc: Beach city with the Pier, Third Street Promenade and the E Line to DTLA. Walkable, sunny and safe-feeling, popular with SMC/UCLA students and tech workers; rents are high.
desc_zh: 海滨城市，有圣莫尼卡码头和第三街步行街，E线轻轨直达市中心；步行友好、阳光充足，SMC/UCLA学生和科技从业者多，租金偏高。

name: Venice
desc: Boardwalk, canals and Abbot Kinney's boutiques give Venice a creative, beachy vibe. Bikeable to Santa Monica and Silicon Beach offices; small bungalows rent at a premium.
desc_zh: 海滨木栈道、运河和Abbot Kinney街小店，氛围文艺随性；骑车可到圣莫尼卡和“硅滩”办公区，小平房租金不便宜。

name: Marina del Rey
desc: Harbor-front apartment complexes with pools, bike paths and sunsets over the boats. Calm and resort-like, close to LMU and Playa Vista; you'll want a car.
desc_zh: 港湾旁的公寓社区，带泳池、自行车道和游艇夕阳，环境安静、度假感强，靠近LMU和Playa Vista；基本需要开车。

name: Playa Vista
desc: A newer master-planned community of modern apartments, parks and tech offices. Clean and quiet near LMU and the beach; getting around is mostly by car.
desc_zh: 新规划社区，现代公寓、公园和科技公司办公室集中；干净安静，靠近LMU和海滩，出行以开车为主。

name: Westwood
desc: UCLA's college town: Westwood Village shops, cinemas and dense apartments within walking distance of campus. Practical for students; rents are high for the size.
desc_zh: UCLA所在的大学城，Westwood Village商店、影院和公寓密集，步行即可到校；对学生很方便，但按面积算租金偏高。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Brentwood
desc: Leafy, upscale residential area west of UCLA with San Vicente's cafés and quiet streets. Safe and calm, mostly pricier apartments; a car or bike helps.
desc_zh: UCLA以西的高档住宅区，绿树成荫，San Vicente大道咖啡店多、街道安静；安全宁静，公寓租金偏高，最好有车或自行车。

name: Culver City
desc: Compact, walkable downtown with restaurants, studios and the E Line. Popular with creatives and tech workers; mid-to-high rents, between the Westside and DTLA.
desc_zh: 市中心紧凑好逛，餐厅、影视公司林立，有E线轻轨；创意和科技从业者喜爱，租金中高，位于西区与市中心之间。

name: Century City
desc: High-rise condos and offices around the Westfield mall, minutes from Beverly Hills and UCLA. Polished and convenient but car-oriented; rents are premium.
desc_zh: Westfield商场周边的高层公寓和写字楼，几分钟到比佛利山和UCLA；精致便利但以车为主，租金高端。

name: Beverly Hills
desc: Palm-lined streets, Rodeo Drive and excellent safety. Apartments south of Wilshire are the attainable option; pricey overall but central to the Westside.
desc_zh: 棕榈大道、罗迪欧大道，治安极好；Wilshire以南的公寓相对可负担，整体价格偏高，但位于西区中心。

name: West Hollywood
desc: Walkable, lively city known for the Sunset Strip, nightlife and a strong LGBTQ+ community. Lots of apartments and cafés; rents are high but car-light living is possible.
desc_zh: 以日落大道夜生活和LGBTQ+社区闻名，步行友好、热闹；公寓和咖啡店多，租金较高，但少开车也能生活。

credits.author: No machine-readable author provided. Greenmnm69 assumed (based on copyright claims).

name: Koreatown
desc: One of LA's densest, liveliest areas: late-night Korean food, karaoke and big older apartment buildings. B/D Metro lines, close to USC and DTLA; relatively affordable.
desc_zh: 洛杉矶最密集热闹的街区之一，深夜韩餐、KTV和老式公寓楼林立；有B/D线地铁，靠近USC和市中心，租金相对实惠。

name: Silver Lake
desc: Hilly, artsy east-side neighborhood with indie cafés, the reservoir loop and a young creative crowd. Mostly small complexes and duplexes; mid-to-high rents, car helpful.
desc_zh: 东区丘陵上的文艺街区，独立咖啡馆、水库环线步道，年轻创意人群多；多为小型公寓和双拼屋，租金中高，最好有车。

name: Los Feliz
desc: Charming area below Griffith Park and the Observatory, with Vermont Ave's cafés and bookstores. Classic apartment buildings near the B Line; moderately pricey.
desc_zh: 位于格里菲斯公园和天文台脚下，Vermont大道咖啡店、书店云集；经典老公寓多，靠近B线地铁，租金中等偏高。

name: Highland Park
desc: Northeast LA's revived Figueroa corridor of vintage shops, bars and taco spots. Near Occidental College with A Line light rail; still cheaper than the Westside.
desc_zh: 东北洛杉矶复兴的Figueroa商业街，古着店、酒吧和塔可店多；靠近西方学院，有A线轻轨，租金仍比西区便宜。

name: Eagle Rock
desc: Laid-back hillside area around Occidental College with Colorado Blvd's cafés. Quieter, greener and family-friendly; moderate rents, a car is useful.
desc_zh: 西方学院周边的悠闲山坡社区，Colorado大道咖啡店多；安静绿化好，适合家庭，租金适中，建议有车。

credits.author: The original uploader was Geographer at English Wikipedia.

name: Pasadena
desc: Historic small city with walkable Old Pasadena, Caltech and ArtCenter. Clean, safe and cultured, with the A Line to DTLA; rents moderate to high.
desc_zh: 历史小城，老帕萨迪纳街区适合步行，有加州理工和艺术中心设计学院；干净安全、文化氛围好，A线直达市中心，租金中高。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: DTLA
desc: Skyscrapers, converted lofts and the Arts District at the hub of the Metro network, near USC. Urban with many new amenity buildings; some blocks feel rough at night.
desc_zh: 摩天楼、loft改造公寓和艺术区汇聚，是地铁网络枢纽，靠近USC；城市感强、新楼设施多，部分街区夜间治安一般。

name: DTLA
desc: Financial District, South Park, Arts District and Historic Core: entertainment, finance, law, tech and startups.
desc_zh: 包括金融区、South Park、艺术区和历史核心区，娱乐、金融、法律、科技和初创企业集中。

name: Century City
desc: Office towers beside the Westfield mall: an entertainment, law and finance hub with heavy daytime employment.
desc_zh: Westfield商场旁的写字楼群，娱乐、法律和金融中心，白天就业人口密集。

name: Culver City
desc: Entertainment, tech and creative offices mixed with restaurants and apartments; Downtown and the Arts District are distinct hubs.
desc_zh: 娱乐、科技和创意办公与餐厅、公寓混合；市中心和艺术区是两个独立的商务片区。

name: Santa Monica
desc: Beachside and walkable, with tech offices and retail: the core of LA's "Silicon Beach".
desc_zh: 海滨、步行友好，科技办公和零售集中，是洛杉矶“硅滩”的核心。

name: Playa Vista
desc: Master-planned community with a dense cluster of tech companies and new apartments.
desc_zh: 规划型社区，科技公司密集，新建公寓众多。

name: Burbank
desc: Media and entertainment hub, home to major studios and production company offices.
desc_zh: 传媒与娱乐中心，多家大型制片厂和制作公司办公室所在地。

name: Hollywood
desc: Core of the entertainment industry: studios, production, talent agencies and tourism.
desc_zh: 娱乐产业核心，制片厂、制作公司、经纪公司和旅游业集中。

name: Beverly Hills
desc: Luxury retail, hospitality and professional services in a brand- and lifestyle-driven district.
desc_zh: 奢侈品零售、酒店和专业服务集中，以品牌和生活方式为导向的商务区。

name: Pasadena
desc: Independent small-city business district: schools, offices and Old Pasadena retail.
desc_zh: 独立小城的商务区，学校、写字楼和老帕萨迪纳零售并存。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: El Segundo
desc: Aerospace, tech and corporate offices next to LAX.
desc_zh: 毗邻洛杉矶国际机场，航空航天、科技和企业办公集中。

name: Georgetown
desc: Historic brick rowhouses, M Street shopping and the C&O Canal next to Georgetown University. Charming and safe, but no Metro station and rents are high.
desc_zh: 历史红砖排屋、M街购物和C&O运河，紧邻乔治城大学；迷人安全，但没有地铁站，租金偏高。

credits.author: Warren LeMay from Cincinnati, OH, United States
Warren LeMay from Cincinnati, OH, United States

name: Dupont Circle
desc: Lively circle of rowhouses, embassies, bookstores and cafés on the Red Line. Very walkable and social, popular with young professionals and GWU/Georgetown students.
desc_zh: 排屋、使馆、书店和咖啡馆环绕的热闹街区，红线地铁直达；步行便利、社交氛围好，年轻上班族和GWU/乔治城学生多。

name: Foggy Bottom
desc: Home to GWU, the State Department and the Kennedy Center, with its own Metro stop. Convenient for GW students; quieter at night, mid-to-high rents.
desc_zh: 乔治华盛顿大学、国务院和肯尼迪中心所在地，自带地铁站；GW学生通勤方便，夜间较安静，租金中高。

name: Logan Circle
desc: Victorian rowhouses around a leafy circle, steps from 14th Street's restaurants and bars. Stylish and walkable, popular with young professionals; rents are high.
desc_zh: 绿树环岛周围的维多利亚式排屋，紧邻14街的餐厅和酒吧；时尚、步行友好，年轻上班族喜爱，租金较高。

credits.author: Ted Eytan from Washington, DC, USA

name: Shaw
desc: Fast-changing area near Howard University and U Street with music venues, bars and new apartments. Green/Yellow lines; energetic and a bit cheaper than Logan Circle.
desc_zh: 靠近霍华德大学和U街，音乐场馆、酒吧和新公寓不断涌现，有绿/黄线地铁；氛围活跃，租金略低于Logan Circle。

name: NoMa
desc: New high-rise rentals north of Union Station near Gallaudet and Union Market. Red Line and Amtrak make commuting easy; modern but still filling in.
desc_zh: 联合车站以北新建高层公寓区，靠近加劳德特大学和Union Market；红线和Amtrak通勤便利，现代化但仍在发展中。

name: Capitol Hill
desc: Tree-lined rowhouse streets around the Capitol and Eastern Market. Calm, with a real community feel and many Hill staffers; Blue/Orange/Silver lines.
desc_zh: 国会大厦和东方市场周边，林荫街道和排屋，社区感强、氛围安静，国会工作人员多；蓝/橙/银线地铁。

name: Navy Yard
desc: Riverfront district of new apartment towers, Nationals Park and Yards Park. Modern amenities on the Green Line; lively on game days, mid-to-high rents.
desc_zh: 河滨新区，新建公寓楼、国民公园球场和Yards Park；设施现代，有绿线地铁，比赛日很热闹，租金中高。

name: Downtown DC
desc: Consulting, law, corporate offices and associations; close to Logan Circle and Dupont.
desc_zh: 咨询、法律、企业办公和行业协会集中，靠近Logan Circle和杜邦环岛。

name: K Street
desc: Lobbying, law, public affairs and consulting; near Dupont, Logan Circle and Foggy Bottom.
desc_zh: 游说、法律、公共事务和咨询机构集中，靠近杜邦环岛、Logan Circle和雾谷。

name: Penn Quarter / Chinatown
desc: Law, associations, media and hospitality; near Downtown and Mt Vernon Triangle.
desc_zh: 法律、行业协会、传媒和酒店业集中，靠近市中心和Mt Vernon Triangle。

name: Foggy Bottom
desc: State Department, World Bank, IMF, healthcare and GWU; near the West End and Georgetown.
desc_zh: 美国国务院、世界银行、IMF、医疗机构和GWU所在地，靠近West End和乔治城。

name: Capitol Hill
desc: Congress, government and policy work; near Navy Yard and NoMa.
desc_zh: 国会、政府和政策机构集中，靠近Navy Yard和NoMa。

name: NoMa
desc: Government agencies, tech, nonprofits and offices; near Union Market.
desc_zh: 政府机构、科技公司、非营利组织和写字楼集中，靠近Union Market。

name: Navy Yard
desc: Federal agencies, defense-related firms and new offices; near Capitol Hill.
desc_zh: 联邦机构、国防相关企业和新写字楼集中，靠近国会山。

name: Rosslyn
desc: Consulting, defense and corporate HQs across the river in Arlington; near Courthouse and Clarendon.
desc_zh: 河对岸阿灵顿的咨询、国防和企业总部集中地，靠近Courthouse和Clarendon。

name: Crystal City / National Landing
desc: Defense, government contractors and Amazon HQ2; near Pentagon City.
desc_zh: 国防、政府承包商和亚马逊第二总部所在地，靠近Pentagon City。

name: Bethesda
desc: Biotech, healthcare and consulting, home to NIH; near Chevy Chase.
desc_zh: 生物科技、医疗和咨询集中，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）所在地，靠近Chevy Chase。

credits.author: John Brighenti from Rockville, MD, United States

name: The Loop
desc: Downtown Chicago under the 'L': high-rise apartments, theaters, Millennium Park and every train line. Ultra-convenient for SAIC and Columbia students; quieter at night.
desc_zh: 芝加哥市中心，高架轨道环绕，高层公寓、剧院、千禧公园和所有地铁线汇聚；SAIC和哥伦比亚学院学生通勤极便利，晚上较安静。

name: West Loop
desc: Former warehouse district turned dining hotspot, with Randolph's Restaurant Row, lofts and new towers. Near UIC; trendy and pricey, Green/Pink lines.
desc_zh: 由仓库区转型的美食热点，Randolph街餐厅一条街、loft和新高楼林立；靠近UIC，时髦且租金偏高，有绿/粉线。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: River North
desc: Galleries, restaurants and nightlife just north of the river, full of high-rise rentals. Central and lively on the Red/Brown lines; popular with young professionals, rents high.
desc_zh: 芝加哥河北岸，画廊、餐厅和夜生活集中，高层出租公寓多；位置居中、热闹，有红/棕线，年轻上班族多，租金较高。

credits.author: Jaysin Trevino from Evanston, IL, US
Jaysin Trevino from Evanston, IL, US

name: Lincoln Park
desc: Leafy streets of brownstones near DePaul, the zoo and the lakefront park. Safe, social and student-friendly; Red/Brown/Purple lines at Fullerton.
desc_zh: 褐石建筑与林荫街道，靠近德保罗大学、动物园和湖滨公园；安全、社交氛围好、适合学生，Fullerton站有红/棕/紫线。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: Lakeview
desc: Big, lively North Side area including Wrigleyville and Boystown, with bars, lakefront paths and plenty of apartments. Red/Brown lines; good value for young renters.
desc_zh: 北区大型热闹社区，包括Wrigleyville和Boystown，酒吧多、有湖滨步道，公寓选择丰富；红/棕线，年轻租客性价比高。

credits.author: subbu arumugam from chicago, united states
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Wicker Park / Bucktown
desc: Indie shops, music venues and coffee bars around Six Corners, plus The 606 trail. Hip and walkable on the Blue Line; mid-to-high rents in two-flats and lofts.
desc_zh: 六岔路口周边独立小店、音乐场所和咖啡馆，还有606高架步道；时髦好逛，蓝线直达，双层小楼和loft租金中高。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: Hyde Park
desc: UChicago's lakeside neighborhood with stately buildings, bookstores and the Museum of Science and Industry. Quiet and academic; Metra to downtown, moderate rents.
desc_zh: 芝加哥大学所在的湖滨社区，建筑典雅、书店多，有科学与工业博物馆；安静、学术氛围浓，Metra通勤市中心，租金适中。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: South Loop
desc: High-rises near Grant Park, Museum Campus and Columbia College, plus Printer's Row lofts. Easy Red/Green/Orange access; good value compared with the Loop.
desc_zh: 格兰特公园、博物馆园区和哥伦比亚学院附近的高层公寓区，还有Printer's Row的loft；红/绿/橙线方便，性价比高于Loop。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: Streeterville
desc: Lakefront high-rises between the Magnificent Mile and Navy Pier, home to Northwestern's medical campus. Upscale and convenient; rents among Chicago's highest.
desc_zh: 华丽一英里与海军码头之间的湖滨高楼区，西北大学医学院所在地；高档便利，租金属芝加哥最高之列。

name: Old Town
desc: Historic streets with Second City comedy, Wells Street bars and brick rowhouses near Lincoln Park. Charming and safe on the Brown/Purple lines; moderately pricey.
desc_zh: 历史街区，有Second City喜剧剧场、Wells街酒吧和红砖排屋，靠近林肯公园；迷人安全，棕/紫线，租金中等偏高。

name: Logan Square
desc: Wide boulevards, a weekly farmers market and a strong bar and café scene. Young and creative, on the Blue Line to O'Hare and downtown; still reasonably priced.
desc_zh: 宽阔林荫大道、每周农夫市集，酒吧咖啡文化浓厚；年轻有创意，蓝线可到奥黑尔机场和市中心，租金仍较合理。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: Rogers Park / Edgewater
desc: Diverse lakefront neighborhoods around Loyola with beaches, vintage courtyard buildings and the Red Line. Among the most affordable North Side options for students.
desc_zh: 罗耀拉大学周边的多元湖滨社区，有海滩、老式庭院公寓和红线地铁；北区对学生最实惠的选择之一。

name: Andersonville
desc: Swedish-rooted, LGBTQ+-friendly strip of indie shops and restaurants on Clark Street. Calm, friendly and walkable near the Red Line; moderate rents.
desc_zh: 源自瑞典移民的街区，Clark街独立小店和餐厅林立，对LGBTQ+友好；安静友善、适合步行，近红线，租金适中。

name: Bronzeville
desc: Historic heart of Black Chicago with greystone mansions, near IIT and the lakefront. Green Line access; affordable, with ongoing revitalization.
desc_zh: 芝加哥非裔历史文化中心，灰石大宅林立，靠近伊利诺伊理工和湖滨；绿线直达，租金实惠，正在复兴中。

name: Woodlawn
desc: South of the Midway, next to UChicago and Jackson Park, home of the Obama Presidential Center. Affordable rents and new development; check blocks carefully for safety.
desc_zh: Midway以南，紧邻芝加哥大学和杰克逊公园（奥巴马总统中心所在地）；租金实惠、新开发多，选房时需仔细了解街区治安。

name: The Loop
desc: Finance, law, government and consulting; near the South Loop and River North.
desc_zh: 金融、法律、政府和咨询机构集中，靠近South Loop和River North。

name: West Loop / Fulton Market
desc: Tech, consulting, corporate HQs and food businesses; near Fulton Market and River West.
desc_zh: 科技、咨询、企业总部和餐饮业集中，靠近Fulton Market和River West。

name: River North
desc: Tech, media, design and hospitality; near Streeterville.
desc_zh: 科技、传媒、设计和酒店业集中，靠近Streeterville。

credits.author: Jaysin Trevino from Evanston, IL, US
Jaysin Trevino from Evanston, IL, US

name: Streeterville / Magnificent Mile
desc: Healthcare, retail and hospitality; near the Gold Coast.
desc_zh: 医疗、零售和酒店业集中，靠近黄金海岸。

credits.author: Warren LeMay from Covington, KY, United States
Roger W from Sarasota, Florida, U.S.A.

name: LaSalle Street Corridor
desc: Finance, banking and law, anchored by the Board of Trade; near the Loop and River North.
desc_zh: 金融、银行和法律机构集中，以芝加哥期货交易所大楼为地标，靠近Loop和River North。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Fulton Market
desc: Tech, startups and corporate offices in converted warehouses; near the West Loop.
desc_zh: 仓库改造的办公区，科技、初创和企业办公集中，靠近West Loop。

credits.author: Chris Rycroft from Madison, Wisconsin, United States

name: Medical District
desc: Healthcare, biotech and research; near Little Italy and UIC.
desc_zh: 医疗、生物科技和科研机构集中，靠近小意大利和UIC。

name: O'Hare / Rosemont
desc: Corporate offices, logistics and aviation beside O'Hare; near the northwest suburbs.
desc_zh: 奥黑尔机场旁，企业办公、物流和航空业集中，靠近西北郊区。

name: Evanston
desc: Education, healthcare and professional services, anchored by Northwestern University.
desc_zh: 教育、医疗和专业服务集中，以西北大学为核心。

credits.author: Eric Fredericks from Rancho Cordova, CA, United States

name: Rittenhouse Square
desc: Philadelphia's most elegant address: a leafy square ringed by cafés, shops and high-rises. Walkable to Center City offices and Penn; rents are the city's highest.
desc_zh: 费城最优雅的地段，绿树广场四周咖啡馆、商店和高楼环绕；步行可到市中心办公区和宾大，租金全市最高。

name: University City
desc: Home to Penn and Drexel: student housing, Victorian twins and new towers near 30th Street Station. Very convenient for students; prices vary block by block.
desc_zh: 宾大和德雷塞尔大学所在地，学生公寓、维多利亚式双拼屋和新高楼并存，靠近30街车站；学生生活很方便，租金因街区而异。

name: Fitler Square
desc: Quiet, leafy pocket of brick rowhouses by the Schuylkill River Trail. Walk or bike to Penn and Rittenhouse; peaceful and upscale, with limited inventory.
desc_zh: 斯古吉尔河步道旁宁静的红砖排屋小区，绿树成荫；步行或骑车可到宾大和Rittenhouse，安静高档，房源较少。

name: Logan Square
desc: Grand boulevard area along the Benjamin Franklin Parkway with museums, Swann Fountain and high-rises. Calm and central; mid-to-high rents.
desc_zh: 本杰明·富兰克林大道沿线，博物馆、斯旺喷泉和高层公寓汇聚；安静又居中，租金中高。

name: Old City
desc: Cobblestone lanes by Independence Hall with converted lofts, galleries and bars. Historic and lively on the Market-Frankford Line; lofts at mid-range prices.
desc_zh: 独立厅旁的鹅卵石街巷，loft改造公寓、画廊和酒吧林立；历史感与活力兼具，有Market-Frankford线，loft价格中等。

name: Society Hill
desc: Colonial brick rowhouses, gas lamps and I.M. Pei's towers near the Delaware River. Quiet, safe and refined, walkable to Jefferson and Center City; rents on the higher side.
desc_zh: 殖民时期红砖排屋、煤气灯和贝聿铭设计的高楼，靠近特拉华河；安静安全、格调高，步行可到杰斐逊大学和市中心，租金偏高。

name: Washington Square West / Midtown Village
desc: Lively, LGBTQ+-friendly 'Gayborhood' of restaurants and bars near Jefferson and its hospitals. Walkable and central; rowhouse units and mid-rises at moderate rents.
desc_zh: 热闹且LGBTQ+友好的“Gayborhood”，餐厅酒吧多，靠近杰斐逊大学及其医院；步行便利、位置居中，排屋和中层公寓租金适中。

name: Fishtown
desc: Former industrial area now known for breweries, music venues and new construction along Frankford Ave. Young and buzzing on the El; good value for newer units.
desc_zh: 昔日工业区，如今以精酿酒厂、音乐场所和Frankford大道新建公寓闻名；年轻热闹，有El高架线，新房性价比高。

name: Northern Liberties
desc: Converted warehouses, new apartments and Liberties Walk just north of Old City. Social and walkable with bars and parks; El access, mid-range rents.
desc_zh: Old City以北，仓库改造和新公寓林立，有Liberties Walk步行街；酒吧公园多、社交氛围好，El线可达，租金中等。

name: Fairmount
desc: Rowhouse neighborhood by the Art Museum, Eastern State Penitentiary and Fairmount Park. Friendly and residential with good bars, close to the river trails; mid-range rents.
desc_zh: 费城艺术博物馆、东州监狱和费尔芒特公园旁的排屋社区；友好宜居、小酒吧不错，靠近河滨步道，租金中等。

name: Manayunk
desc: Hilly river town with Main Street's bars and boutiques and a canal towpath. Popular with young grads, Regional Rail to Center City; rents below downtown.
desc_zh: 依山傍河的小镇，Main Street酒吧和小店林立，有运河步道；深受毕业生欢迎，区域铁路到市中心，租金低于市中心。

credits.author: Mr. Matté (if there is an issue with this image, contact me using this image's Commons talk page, my Commons user tal...

name: Center City
desc: Finance, law, consulting and corporate offices; near Rittenhouse, Logan Square and Midtown Village.
desc_zh: 金融、法律、咨询和企业办公集中，靠近Rittenhouse、Logan Square和Midtown Village。

name: Market Street West
desc: Corporate, finance, law and professional services under the city's tallest towers; near Rittenhouse and Logan Square.
desc_zh: 费城最高楼群所在地，企业、金融、法律和专业服务集中，靠近Rittenhouse和Logan Square。

name: University City
desc: Healthcare, biotech, life sciences, education and research; near Fitler Square.
desc_zh: 医疗、生物科技、生命科学、教育和科研集中，靠近Fitler Square。

name: Market East
desc: Retail, hospitality, government and entertainment; near Old City and Washington Square West.
desc_zh: 零售、酒店、政府和娱乐业集中，靠近Old City和Washington Square West。

name: Navy Yard
desc: Life sciences, corporate, engineering and logistics campus; near South Philly.
desc_zh: 生命科学、企业、工程和物流园区，靠近南费城。

name: Old City
desc: Creative, design, startups and hospitality; near Society Hill.
desc_zh: 创意、设计、初创企业和酒店业集中，靠近Society Hill。

name: King of Prussia
desc: Corporate offices, retail (one of the largest US malls) and healthcare; near the Main Line suburbs.
desc_zh: 企业办公、零售（全美最大商场之一）和医疗集中，靠近Main Line郊区。
region_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士王

name: Conshohocken
desc: Finance, corporate, healthcare and professional services on the Schuylkill; near Manayunk.
desc_zh: 斯古吉尔河畔，金融、企业、医疗和专业服务集中，靠近Manayunk。
region_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州康舍霍肯
